QUOTE: "#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member
#else
#define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member
#endif" and "Without the define, the field is really named `private_foo`... With the define, the field is named `foo`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows the macro renames the member to private_<member> by default and expands to the bare member name when MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS is defined.
